note: Set A is better because it extracts all three pixel resolution values and all three camera detectors, whereas Set B misses pixel resolution for the Red and IR channels and misses camera detectors for Blue and IR. Set A also captures more wavelength bands and spectrometer types. While Set B correctly includes OWA values and spectrometer detectors which Set A misses, the omission of key camera performance metrics (pixel resolution) in Set B is a more significant gap in completeness for this specification table.
